record: Rule-6 mutants for the contract-index YAML validity and header-citation repair (syzygy-ejm3; PR 294 review syzygy-qb2s). Not authority.
method: Each mutant replaces every occurrence of `old` with `new` in one file of a fresh `git archive <commit> .syzygy` extraction, then runs `command` from that extraction's root. A mutant is killed only when it replaced at least one occurrence, the command exits nonzero, and its output contains `expected`. M1 and M7 are the unquoted-emit mutants the acceptance criteria name.
finding: On the first run M1 (scalar() returning the bare value) exited 1 but was scored not killed: it was expected to fail 'the generated index parses with yaml.safe_load', and that case passed. PyYAML reads the unquoted rows of the real corpus as *different* YAML (a comma inside a flow mapping becomes a new implicit-null key) rather than rejecting them. The round-trip case, which compares each loaded value with the projected string, is what kills it, so M1's expectation names that case. A parse-only check would have certified wrong data as valid.

runner:
"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-ejm3: each is applied to a fresh copy of .syzygy/
at the given commit; the expected check must fail on its own predicate."""
import json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

REPO = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
COMMIT = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
C = ".syzygy/governance/contracts/candidates"
GEN = f"{C}/scripts/build_contract_index.py"
VER = f"{C}/scripts/verify_final_prespec.py"
README = f"{C}/rfcs/RFC-0002/README.md"
INDEX = f"{C}/05-CONTRACT-INDEX.yaml"

MUTANTS = [
    # (id, kind, file, old, new, command, expected substring in output)
    ("M1", "generator", GEN,
     "    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)",
     "    return value",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: every title, status_source, module range and module list reads back as projected"),
    ("M2", "generator", GEN,
     "            and not YAML_RESERVED.match(value)):",
     "            ):",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: hostile titles load back as the same strings"),
    ("M3", "generator", GEN,
     "            and not PLAIN_FORBIDDEN.search(value)",
     "",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: hostile titles load back as the same strings"),
    ("M4", "generator", GEN,
     "{scalar(status_projection(e['status']))}",
     "{status_projection(e['status'])}",
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: an [Unknown] status_source row still parses, as a string"),
    ("M5", "generator", GEN,
     'return "[" + ", ".join(scalar(v) for v in values) + "]"',
     'return "[" + ", ".join(values) + "]"',
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: hostile list items load back as the same strings"),
    ("M6", "generator", GEN,
     '"# never a second truth store (RFC11-7); a contract\'s effective status lies",',
     '"# never a second truth store; a contract\'s effective status lies",',
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: the header cites RFC11-7 for the projection and RFC3-16"),
    ("M7", "generator", GEN,
     'lines.append(f"    title: {scalar(fm[\'title\'])}")',
     'lines.append(f"    title: {fm[\'title\']}")',
     "--selftest", "SELFTEST FAIL: hostile titles load back as the same strings"),
    ("I1", "input", INDEX,
     'clauses: "RFC9-1..RFC9-23',
     'clauses: RFC9-1..RFC9-23',
     "--check", "DRIFT: 05-CONTRACT-INDEX.yaml differs from regeneration"),
]

results = []
for mid, kind, rel, old, new, flag, expect in MUTANTS:
    tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"ejm3-{mid}-"))
    try:
        archive = subprocess.run(["git", "archive", COMMIT, ".syzygy"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
        subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(tmp)], input=archive, check=True)
        target = tmp / rel
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        occurrences = text.count(old)
        target.write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(tmp / GEN), flag], cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = run.stdout + run.stderr
        killed = occurrences >= 1 and run.returncode != 0 and expect in out
        results.append({"id": mid, "kind": kind, "file": rel, "old": old, "new": new,
                        "occurrencesReplaced": occurrences, "command": f"python3 {GEN} {flag}",
                        "expected": expect, "exitCode": run.returncode, "killed": killed,
                        "outputTail": out.strip().splitlines()[-3:]})
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)

print(json.dumps({"commit": COMMIT, "mutants": results,
                  "killed": sum(r["killed"] for r in results), "total": len(results)}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
